paragraphs.en: The torchlight revealed six pirates inside the blockhouse, confirming my worst fears. The cask of cognac, pork, and bread were untouched, yet there was no sign of any prisoners, intensifying my horror.
paragraphs.zh: 手电筒的光束照射下，我发现木堡内有六个海盗，这证实了我的最坏猜想。酒桶里的科涅克白兰地、熏肉和面包完好无损，但没有任何囚犯的踪迹，这更加深了我心中的恐惧。

paragraphs.en: Five pirates were flushed from drunkenness, while one, pale and bandaged, had recently been wounded. I recognized him as the man who fled during our last attack.
paragraphs.zh: 五名海盗醉醺醺地被赶了出来，其中一人苍白且缠着绷带，最近受了伤。我认出他就是上次袭击时逃跑的那个人。

paragraphs.en: Long John Silver sat on a brandy cask, his suit torn and stained. He greeted me with a stern look, offering me a pipe. "So here's Jim Hawkins," he said, "shiver my timbers!
paragraphs.zh: 长约翰·银坐在一个 BRANDY 桶上，衣衫褴褛，满是污渍。他用一种严肃的目光打量着我，递给我一根烟斗。“原来是你，吉姆霍金斯，”他说道，“天哪，你可真让我大吃一惊！”

paragraphs.en: Dropped in like that, eh? Well, come, I take that friendly."
paragraphs.zh: 就这样突然出现了啊？好吧，我理解这是友好的意思。

paragraphs.en: He filled the pipe and lit it, then instructed Dick to place the glowing ember in the wood heap. To the other pirates, he said, "You needn't stand up for Mr. Hawkins; HE'LL excuse you." He paused, adding, "Here you were, a pleasant surprise for poor old John."
paragraphs.zh: 他填满了烟斗，点上火，然后吩咐迪克把燃着的火星放在木堆里。他对其他海盗说：“你们不必为霍金斯先生辩护；他会原谅你们的。”他说完这句话，顿了顿，又补充道：“你啊，真是让老约翰喜出望外的一个惊喜。”

paragraphs.en: I stood against the wall, outwardly composed but inwardly despairing. Silver took several puffs of his pipe with composure before continuing.
paragraphs.zh: 我靠在墙上，表面上镇定自若，内心却充满绝望。银爵抽了几口烟斗，神情依旧从容不迫，然后继续说道。

paragraphs.en: Jim is now faced with Silver’s direct advice: "Be as you ARE," Silver says, recalling his own youthful spirit. He praises Jim and urges him to join their crew, promising a life of gentlemanly honor. Despite Smollett's strict discipline, he acknowledges duty.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆现在面对的是西尔弗直截了当的建议：“做你本来的样子。”西尔弗回忆起自己年轻时的精神，称赞了吉姆一番，并敦促他加入他们的船员队伍，承诺将过上充满绅士荣誉的生活。尽管斯莫利特船长纪律严明，他也承认了自己的职责所在。

paragraphs.en: However, Jim must avoid the captain.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，吉姆必须避开船长。

paragraphs.en: Silver explains that while they have him now, he advocates for argument over threats. If Jim wants to stay, he will; if not, he is free to refuse. The doctor has passed out again, calling Jim an "ungrateful scamp."
paragraphs.zh: 银色解释说，他们现在掌控着他，但他主张用论理说服而非威胁。如果吉姆想留下，他自然会留下；如果不留，完全可以拒绝。医生又昏了过去，口中还在叫嚷着吉姆是个“不知好歹的家伙”。

paragraphs.en: Silver concludes that without starting a new ship's company, Jim must join them.
paragraphs.zh: 银色得出结论，除非组建新的船员队伍，否则吉姆必须加入他们。

paragraphs.en: Jim remains uncertain but asks, "Am I to answer?" Despite the sneering, he feels the threat of death looming over him. Silver reassures him, saying no one is forcing his decision and that time passes pleasantly with him aboard.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆依然犹豫不决，但还是问道：“我是否应该回答？”尽管对方带着嘲讽的语气，他能感受到死亡的威胁如影随形。塞弗尔安慰他说，并没有人强迫他的决定，而与他同船的日子里时光倒流般惬意。

paragraphs.en: Jim grows bolder and demands to know why they are there and where his friends are. One buccaneer grumbles, "Wot's wot?" emphasizing the mystery surrounding their situation.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆胆子越来越大，质问他们来这里的目的以及他的朋友们在哪里。一个海盗咕哝道：“这是怎么回事？”语气中充满了对他们处境的不解和疑惑。

paragraphs.en: Silver spoke harshly to the speaker: "You'll batten down your hatches until spoken to." Then, in a more gracious tone, he addressed me: "Yesterday morning, Mr. Hawkins, during the dog-watch, Doctor Livesey arrived with a flag of truce. He said, 'Cap'n Silver, you're sold out.
paragraphs.zh: Silver 对说话的人严厉地说：“你最好闭上嘴，等我吩咐才开口。”然后语气一转，转向我说道：“霍金斯先生，昨天早上，在狗哨班次的时候，莱维塞医生带着停战旗来了。他说：‘银长官，你完了。’”

paragraphs.en: Ship's gone.' We had been drinking and singing, but when we looked outside, the ship was indeed gone—never seen such fools before. The doctor suggested a bargain, which we agreed to.
paragraphs.zh: 船已经走了。我们刚才还在喝酒唱歌，但一看外面，船真的不见了——真是没见过这么不靠谱的人。医生提议做个交易，我们都答应了。

paragraphs.en: In return for stores, brandy, and the blockhouse, as well as firewood you cut, we have the whole boat from cross-trees to kelson.
paragraphs.zh: 作为交换，你们不仅能得到补给、白兰地和炮台，还能得到整条船，从横梁到龙骨。

paragraphs.en: Silver continued: "And just in case you think you're part of this agreement, here's what was said last: 'How many are leaving?' I asked. He replied, 'Four, and one wounded.
paragraphs.zh: Silver 继续说道：“而且，以防你认为自己是这份协议的一部分，这里再说一遍上次的内容：‘有多少人要离开？’我问道。他回答说：‘四个人，还有一个受伤的。’”

paragraphs.en: As for that boy, I don't know where he is, nor do I care; we're sick of him.' These were his exact words.
paragraphs.zh: 至于那个男孩，我根本不知道他在哪里，也不关心；我们对他已经厌烦了。这就是他原话说的。

paragraphs.en: Is that all?" I inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “就这些吗？”我问道。

paragraphs.en: Silver responded: "That's all you need to hear, my son."
paragraphs.zh: 赛勒斯回答道：“你只需要记住这一点，我的儿子。”

paragraphs.en: I took a deep breath and began, "Well, I'm not so foolish as to think I can hide what I've done. If things go badly, it doesn't matter much to me. Too many have died since I joined you.
paragraphs.zh: 我深吸了一口气，开始说道：“其实我也不是那么愚蠢，以为自己能把做过的事藏起来。如果事情搞砸了，对我来说也没有太大关系。自从加入你们以来，已经死了太多人。”

paragraphs.en: But there's something I must tell you," I said, my voice rising with excitement.
paragraphs.zh: “不过我必须告诉你一件事，”我说着，声音因为激动而提高了几分。

paragraphs.en: "You are in a bad way—ship lost, treasure gone, men dead, your business ruined. And if you want to know who did it—it was me! I overheard you on the night we sighted land and told every word you spoke before the hour was out.
paragraphs.zh: 你的情况糟透了——船只沉没了，财宝也没了，手下的人也死了，你的生意彻底完了。而且如果你想知道是谁干的——就是我！那天晚上我们看到陆地时，我听到了你的话，并且在不到一小时的时间里就把你说的一切都告诉了别人。

paragraphs.en: As for the schooner, I cut its cable, killed the men aboard, and sank her where none of you will ever find her again."
paragraphs.zh: 至于那艘帆船，我切断了它的缆绳，杀死了船上的人，并将其沉入海底，确保你们永远找不到它。

paragraphs.en: "Laughing is on my side; I've had control from the start. I fear neither you nor a fly. Kill me or spare me—it's up to you.
paragraphs.zh: 笑在我的掌控之中；从一开始我就占了上风。我既不怕你，也不怕苍蝇。杀我还是放我一马，全凭你的决定。

paragraphs.en: But if you spare me, let bygones be bygones. When you stand trial for piracy, I'll do what I can to save you all."
paragraphs.zh: 但如果你饶了我，就让过去的事随风而去吧。等你因海盗罪受审时，我会尽我所能为你求情。”

paragraphs.en: I paused, noticing that none of them moved; they stared at me like sheep. Then, I continued, "Now, Mr. Silver, I believe you're the best here. If things go badly, let the doctor know how I took it."
paragraphs.zh: 我停了下来，发现他们都没有动，只是像羊一样盯着我看。然后我又说道：“现在，塞利文先生，我相信你是这里最好的。如果情况不妙，请医生告诉我你的看法。”

paragraphs.en: Silver replied with an unusual tone, "I'll bear that in mind." His voice was so peculiar that I couldn't tell if he was laughing or impressed by my courage.
paragraphs.zh: 银色以一种不寻常的语气回答：“我会记住的。”他的声音怪异得让我分不清他是笑还是被我的勇气所震撼。

paragraphs.en: Morgan, a mahogany-faced sailor who had been at Long John's pub on Bristol's quays, interjected, "It was him who knew Black Dog."
paragraphs.zh: 摩根是一名有着铜色脸庞的水手，他曾光顾布里斯托尔码头边的长约翰酒吧，他插嘴道：“知道黑狗的人就是他。”

paragraphs.en: The sea-cook added, "Well, and see here. I’ll put another bet on that, by thunder! For it was this same boy who faked the chart from Billy Bones.
paragraphs.zh: 海厨接着说：“好了，你瞧。我再打个赌，雷电轰鸣！就是这个男孩伪造了比尔·博尼斯的航海图。”

paragraphs.en: First and last, we’ve split upon Jim Hawkins!"
paragraphs.zh: 首鼠两端，最终我们还是和吉姆·霍金斯分道扬镳了！

paragraphs.en: "Then here goes!" Morgan swore, springing up with his knife drawn.
paragraphs.zh: “那就来吧！”摩根愤然站起，匕首在手。

paragraphs.en: "Avast there!" Silver cried. "Who are you, Tom Morgan?
paragraphs.zh: “站住！”赛勒斯喊道，“汤姆·摩根，你是什么人？”

paragraphs.en: Maybe you thought you were captain here, perhaps. By the powers, but I’ll teach you better! Cross me, and you’ll go where many a good man’s gone before—some to the yard-arm, shiver my timbers, and some by the board, all to feed the fishes."
paragraphs.zh: 也许你认为自己是这里的船长吧？嘿，我要让你知道更好的道理！要是敢违抗我，你就会和许多好汉一样——有的会被绑在甲板上，让我的船木裂成碎片；有的则会被抛入大海，喂了鱼儿。

paragraphs.en: Morgan paused, but others murmured.
paragraphs.zh: 摩根顿了一下，但其他人低声议论起来。

paragraphs.en: "Tom's right," one said. "I stood hazing long enough from one," another added. "I’ll be hanged if I'll be hazed by you, John Silver."
paragraphs.zh: “汤姆说的没错，”一个人说道，“我早就受够了这种待遇。”另一个人接着说：“我可不会让你，约翰·银斧，再来欺负我了。”

paragraphs.en: Silver bent forward, his pipe still glowing in his hand. "Did any of you gentlemen want to have it out with me? Put a name on what you’re at; you ain’t dumb, I reckon.
paragraphs.zh: 银色向前倾了倾身子，手中的烟斗还在散发着光芒。“你们当中有哪位先生想和我理论一番？把话说明白些；你们可不傻吧，我想。”

paragraphs.en: Him that wants shall get it. Have I lived this many years and let a rum puncheon cock his hat athwart my hawse at the end of it? You know the way; you're all gentlemen o' fortune, by your account.
paragraphs.zh: 想要的自然会得到。我活了这么多年，难道会让一瓶好酒,"); 他猛地一拍桌子，脱口而出，“顶着我的船头，在旅程的终点向我炫耀吗？你们都算是有前途的年轻人，按你们的说法。”

paragraphs.en: Well, I'm ready. Take a cutlass, him that dares, and I'll see the colour of his inside, crutch and all, before that pipe's empty."
paragraphs.zh: 好啦，我准备好了。谁敢拿把砍刀就试试吧，在这烟斗抽空之前，我会让他见识一下里面的东西，连拐杖一起。

paragraphs.en: Not a man stirred or answered.
paragraphs.zh: 没有人动弹也没有人应声。

paragraphs.en: "That’s your sort, is it?" Silver said, returning his pipe to his mouth. "Well, you’re a gay lot to look at, anyway.
paragraphs.zh: “这就是你们的风格吧？”Silver边把烟斗放回嘴里边说，“不过，你们这帮家伙倒也挺招人喜欢的。”

paragraphs.en: Not much worth to fight, you ain’t. Perhaps you can understand King George’s English. I’m captain here by election. I’m captain because I’m the best man by a long sea-mile.
paragraphs.zh: 你根本不算什么值得一战的人。或许你能听懂乔治国王的英语。我是通过选举成为船长的，也是因为我是最优秀的人，这一点差得可不是一点半点。

paragraphs.en: You won't fight as gentlemen o' fortune should; then, by thunder, you'll obey, and you may lay to it! I like that boy now; I never saw a better boy than him. He’s more a man than any pair of rats in this house, and what I say is this: let me see him that’ll lay a hand on him—that's what I say, and you may lay to it."
paragraphs.zh: 你可别像绅士般讲究公平；到时候，哼，你们得乖乖听话！我可以保证！我现在挺喜欢这个孩子；我从没见过比他更好的男孩了。他比这屋子里任何一对耗子都像个男子汉，我的意思是这样：让我看看有谁敢碰他——我说的就是这个意思，你也可以放心。

paragraphs.en: After a long silence, I stood straight against the wall, my heart pounding but now with a glimmer of hope. Silver leaned back, arms crossed, pipe in mouth, as calm as if he were in church. His eyes kept darting to his unruly followers, who drew closer towards the far end of the blockhouse.
paragraphs.zh: 沉默了许久之后，我挺直身子靠在墙上，心中依旧狂跳，但此刻却燃起了一丝希望。银爵靠在椅背上，双臂交叉，口中叼着烟斗，神情平静得仿佛置身于教堂之中。他的目光不断扫向那些桀骜不驯的追随者们，而这些追随者正逐渐向堡垒的远端聚集。

paragraphs.en: Their whispers sounded like a continuous stream in my ear.
paragraphs.zh: 她们的低语在我耳边连绵不绝。

paragraphs.en: "Seems you have much to say," remarked Silver, spitting into the air. "Speak up or shut up."
paragraphs.zh: “看来你有很多话要说呢。”锡尔弗吐了口唾沫道，“要么说，要么闭嘴。”

paragraphs.en: "One moment, sir," replied one man. "You're lenient with some rules; please keep an eye on the rest. This crew is dissatisfied and won't tolerate bullying.
paragraphs.zh: “等一下，先生。”一个人回答道。“你对某些规定比较宽容，请务必留意其他部分。这伙人情绪不佳，不会容忍被欺负的。”

paragraphs.en: We have our rights like any other crew. By your own rules, we can talk here. I apologize, acknowledging you as captain now, but I claim my right to a council."
paragraphs.zh: 我们也有自己的权利，和其他船员一样。按照你自己的规定，我们可以在这里交谈。我现在向你道歉，并承认你是船长，但我要行使我召开会议的权利。

paragraphs.en: With a sea-salute, this man, a tall, yellow-eyed man in his thirties, stepped towards the door and left. The others followed, each making their own salutes and apologies.
paragraphs.zh: 这位三十岁左右、黄眼睛的高个子男子以一个海员式的敬礼走向门口，然后离开了。其他人也纷纷行礼并道别，各自离去。

paragraphs.en: "According to rules," said one. "Forecastle council," added Morgan. One by one, they marched out, leaving Silver and me alone with the torch.
paragraphs.zh: “按照规定，”一个人说道。“前甲板会议，”摩根补充道。他们一个接一个地走了出去，只剩下锡尔弗和我两人，手里还拿着火炬。

paragraphs.en: Silver quickly removed his pipe.
paragraphs.zh: 银色迅速地抽出了烟斗。

paragraphs.en: Jim Hawkins understood the gravity of the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆·霍金斯深知当时局的严重性。

paragraphs.en: "Does this mean all is lost?" he asked Long John.
paragraphs.zh: “这难道意味着一切 hope 都破灭了吗？”他问长腿约翰。

paragraphs.en: "Aye, by gum," replied Long John. "The ship's gone, and so are my chances. I saw no schooner in that bay, and it was too much for me."
paragraphs.zh: “哎呀，见鬼了，”长腿约翰回答道，“船没了，我的机会也没了。我没在那个海湾看到任何快艇，这可把我给难住了。”

paragraphs.en: Long John continued, "That lot with their council? They're fools and cowards. But don't worry, Jim—I'll save your life if I can.
paragraphs.zh: 长腿约翰继续说道：“那些家伙和他们的议会？他们都是笨蛋和懦夫。不过别担心，吉姆——如果我能的话，我会救你的命的。”

paragraphs.en: You must save me from hanging."
paragraphs.zh: 你必须救我免遭绞刑。

paragraphs.en: Jim was bewildered but resolved to help.
paragraphs.zh: 吉姆感到困惑但决心出手相助。

paragraphs.en: "I'll do what I can," he said firmly.
paragraphs.zh: “我尽力而为。”他坚定地说。

paragraphs.en: "Agreed!" exclaimed Long John. "You've got guts, and now I have a chance!"
paragraphs.zh: “成交了！”长腿约翰脱口而出，“你够胆量，现在我有机会了！”

paragraphs.en: He hobbled over to the torch, relighting his pipe.
paragraphs.zh: 他一瘸一拐地走到火把旁，重新点上了烟斗。

paragraphs.en: "Listen, Jim," Long John said as he returned. "I'm on the squire's side now. You've got that ship safe somewhere—I don't know how, but it is.
paragraphs.zh: “吉姆，听着,”长约翰回来后说道，“我现在站在乡绅那边了。那艘船你肯定是安全藏起来了——我不知道你是怎么做到的，但确实如此。”

paragraphs.en: Hands and O'Brien must be softening up. I never trusted them."
paragraphs.zh: 汉斯和奥布赖恩一定正在软化对方的态度。我从一开始就不信任他们。

paragraphs.en: Long John then drew some cognac from a cask into a tin cannikin.
paragraphs.zh: 长约翰随后从酒桶中倒了一些科涅克白兰地到一个锡制的小壶里。

paragraphs.en: "Would you like to taste?" he asked Jim. When Jim declined, Long John said, "I'll have a drink myself.
paragraphs.zh: “你要不要尝一尝？”他问吉姆。吉姆婉拒后，长腿约翰自言自语道：“那我自己来喝一杯吧。”

paragraphs.en: We need to seal this deal with a bit of courage."
paragraphs.zh: 我们得有点勇气把这笔交易敲定。

paragraphs.en: He needed a caulker; there was trouble on the horizon. And then, turning to Jim again, he inquired, "Why did that doctor give me the chart?"
paragraphs.zh: 他需要一个木桶匠；麻烦事似乎已经在不远处等着了。然后，他又转向吉姆问道：“那个医生为什么给我开了一份处方？”

paragraphs.en: He nodded, taking another sip of brandy. "Yes, there is something beneath that, Jim—good or bad." He shook his blond head, clearly expecting the worst.
paragraphs.zh: 他点了点头，又抿了一口 BRANDY，“是的，吉姆，下面确实有东西——可能是好也可能是坏。”他摇着金黄色的脑袋，显然预期最糟的情况。
